inviteOnly: Access is by invitation only. Two-factor authentication is required to protect health data.
idleSignedOut: You were signed out after a period of inactivity, to protect patient data.
enrollSubtitle: It is mandatory: it protects your patients' health data even if someone learns your password.
enrollStep1: Install an authenticator app (for example Aegis, 2FAS, Microsoft or Google Authenticator).
enrollStep2: Scan the QR code, or type in the secret key manually.
enrollStep3: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app.
qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
verifySubtitle: Enter the code generated by your authenticator app.
lostDevice: Lost your phone? Use your backup device if you set one up, or contact the platform administrator.
newPasswordSubtitle: Use a long, unique password that you don't use on other sites.
forgotSubtitle: We'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgotSent: If the address is registered, you'll shortly receive an email with the link.
noOrgSubtitle: Your account is not part of a practice yet. Contact the platform administrator.
